title: Fox holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M52 38 Q56 48 50 58' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->

  <!-- Fox body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#F4A261'/>
  
  <!-- Fox belly -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='78' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#FFE8D6'/>
  
  <!-- Fox head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#F4A261'/>
  
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <polygon points='27,44 24,30 34,40' fill='#F4A261'/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='53.5' rx='2.2' ry='1.8' fill='#2B2D42'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M37 57 Q40 60 43 57' stroke='#2B2D42' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Left arm holding string -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q54 56 52 52' stroke='#F4A261' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M25 66 Q18 62 16 56' stroke='#F4A261' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M58 78 Q72 70 68 58 Q66 54 62 58 Q60 64 54 70' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <path d='M68 58 Q66 54 62 58' fill='#FFE8D6'/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
